product.title: Houston Sightseeing Tour 2.5-hour Air-Conditioned City Tour

description.text: See Houston's core landmarks on a 2.5-hour air-conditioned van tour with hotel pickup from select central locations. The driving circuit covers Market Square, Discovery Green, stadium districts, Buffalo Bayou, and River Oaks homes with a local guide narrating city history. Stops include Market Square, Discovery Green, Toyota Center, Buffalo Bayou, River Oaks. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
